edits.how: All are operator-created host command jobs (`--command-argv`) with no model call: a script fetches a public source, keeps seen ids in a state file and prints one templated line or `NO_REPLY`. Weather (F018): `nws-alerts.mjs` every 30 minutes polls the National Weather Service active-alerts feed for the home point and dedups on the alert id. Schedules and pages (F029, SRC-09): `ics-watch.mjs`, hourly in season, reads a team's subscription link and reports changed events in the next seven days; `watch-page.mjs` every 6 hours uses a site's feed when there is one, otherwise a plain https GET and a text hash. Recalls (SRC-03, SRC-04): `cpsc-recalls.mjs` daily reads CPSC's recall web service and `fda-recalls.mjs` twice a day reads FDA's recalls and safety alerts RSS feed; both are matched locally against owned-item, allergen, staples and medicine keyword lists. The schedule, page and recall jobs are timed inside the allowed hours of the notification policy (G001); only the storm-alert job runs round the clock.
caveats: A parent cannot start a watch from chat: command jobs are created by the operator, so each new watch is a request to Tony.
